name: Gluteus Medius Tendon Tear
definition: Partial or full-thickness tear of the gluteus medius/minimus tendon complex causing lateral hip pain and abductor weakness.

investigations.principle: MRI or ultrasound defines tendon tear and muscle quality.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Targeted abductor rehabilitation for partial/stable tears
amber: Full-thickness tears with persistent disability may require surgical repair.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Shroni-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Partial or full-thickness tear of the gluteus medius/minimus tendon complex causing lateral hip pain and abductor weakness.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
